metadata.title: ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for Hepatocellular Carcinoma

epidemiology.global_burden: Sixth most common cancer and third leading cause of cancer death worldwide

recommendation.target: Patients with cirrhosis of any aetiology at risk of HCC
recommendation.afp: May be added to ultrasound in selected cases

recommendation.target: Non-cirrhotic patients with chronic HBV and high risk (e.g., F3 fibrosis, family history)

surveillance.exclusion: Child-Pugh C patients not listed for transplantation

recommendation.description: Non-invasive diagnosis of HCC in cirrhotic patients using contrast-enhanced CT or MRI
recommendation.criteria: Arterial phase hyperenhancement with washout on portal venous/delayed phase
recommendation.size_threshold: Applicable for nodules 1 cm or greater

li_rads.lr5: Definite HCC - no biopsy required in cirrhosis
li_rads.lr4: Probable HCC - consider biopsy or close follow-up
li_rads.lr_m: Probable malignancy, not HCC-specific - biopsy recommended

biopsy.indication: When tissue diagnosis affects treatment decisions

biomarkers.afp: Not recommended alone for diagnosis; useful in combination with imaging
biomarkers.pet_ct: May be useful for extrahepatic staging; not routine for diagnosis

bclc.recommendation: BCLC staging system recommended for prognosis and treatment allocation

stages.stage: Single less than 2 cm, Child-Pugh A, PS 0
Single or 2-3 nodules up to 3 cm, Child-Pugh A-B, PS 0
Portal invasion/extrahepatic spread, Child-Pugh A-B, PS 1-2

liver_function.albi: ALBI grade provides objective assessment across BCLC stages
liver_function.portal_hypertension: Consider HVPG or indirect markers (platelets, splenomegaly)

extrahepatic_staging.ct_chest: Required for all patients considered for curative or systemic treatment
extrahepatic_staging.bone_scan: If symptoms or elevated alkaline phosphatase

recommendation.indication: BCLC 0/A, Child-Pugh A, no clinically significant portal hypertension

portal_hypertension.contraindication: HVPG greater than 10 mmHg or platelets less than 100,000 with splenomegaly
portal_hypertension.note: Selected patients with mild portal hypertension may be considered

surgical_resection.laparoscopic: Preferred when feasible, especially in cirrhotic patients
surgical_resection.flr: Future liver remnant at least 40% for cirrhotic patients

recommendation.indication: BCLC A/B within transplant criteria with decompensated cirrhosis or portal hypertension

liver_transplantation.milan_criteria: Single tumour up to 5 cm or up to 3 tumours each up to 3 cm, no vascular invasion

extended_criteria.ucsf: Single up to 6.5 cm or up to 3 tumours with largest up to 4.5 cm, total up to 8 cm

bridging.recommendation: Locoregional therapy recommended when waiting time greater than 6 months

downstaging.recommendation: May be considered for patients exceeding criteria
downstaging.observation: 3-6 month observation to assess tumour biology

post_transplant_ici.recommendation: ICIs NOT recommended in post-transplant setting due to rejection risk

recommendation.indication: BCLC 0/A, tumours up to 3 cm, not suitable for resection

modalities.rfa: Standard for tumours less than 3 cm
modalities.mwa: Alternative, may be superior for larger tumours, less heat-sink effect

ablation.combination: Combination with TACE may improve outcomes for 3-5 cm tumours

recommendation.indication: BCLC B (intermediate stage), preserved liver function

technique.deb_tace: Drug-eluting beads - comparable efficacy to conventional
technique.tae: Bland embolisation - may be comparable in some settings

contraindications.item: Extensive bilobar disease with compromised function

tace.refractoriness: Transition to systemic therapy after 2 non-responding TACE sessions

emerald_1.note: First positive trial of TACE plus systemic therapy combination

recommendation.indication: Alternative to TACE for BCLC B, particularly large/infiltrative tumours
May be considered for segmental portal vein invasion

tare.dosimetry: Personalised dosimetry (greater than 205 Gy) improves outcomes
tare.trials: SARAH and SIRveNIB showed non-inferiority to sorafenib

recommendation.description: Combination therapy with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors for advanced HCC

regimen.name: Atezolizumab plus Bevacizumab
regimen.indication: BCLC C or TACE-refractory BCLC B, Child-Pugh A
regimen.egd_requirement: Upper endoscopy within 6 months before treatment

regimen.name: Durvalumab plus Tremelimumab (STRIDE)
regimen.schedule: Single tremelimumab 300 mg plus durvalumab 1500 mg, then durvalumab q4w
regimen.advantage: Alternative for patients unsuitable for bevacizumab

regimen.name: Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab
regimen.schedule: Nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg q3w x 4 cycles, then nivolumab q4w

regimen.name: Lenvatinib
regimen.dose: 12 mg daily (greater than or equal to 60 kg) or 8 mg daily (less than 60 kg)

aetiology_consideration.recommendation: Aetiology should NOT influence systemic therapy choice
aetiology_consideration.evidence: Meta-analyses confirm ICI benefit across all aetiologies including non-viral

second_line.recommendation: TKI recommended after progression on ICI-based combinations

regimen.name: Cabozantinib
regimen.post_ici: Phase II data supports activity after ICI

regimen.name: Ramucirumab
regimen.indication: Second line, AFP greater than or equal to 400 ng/mL

recommendation.description: Not routinely treated outside trials, but Child-Pugh B7-B8 may be considered

child_pugh_b.data: Limited survival benefit; sorafenib mOS 3.6-6 months; atezolizumab-bevacizumab mOS 6-6.7 months

recommendation.description: Sorafenib/lenvatinib may be considered; ICIs NOT recommended

post_transplant_recurrence.ici_risk: High risk of graft rejection with checkpoint inhibitors

oligometastatic_progression.recommendation: Consider local therapy while continuing systemic treatment

ici_discontinuation.recommendation: May discuss discontinuation after sustained response (greater than or equal to 2 years)

treatment_beyond_progression.recommendation: May continue if clinical benefit observed

imb.population: High-risk HCC (microvascular invasion, poor differentiation, larger tumours)
imb.status: First positive adjuvant trial in HCC
imb.recommendation: May be considered for high-risk patients

recommendation.description: RECIST v1.1 as primary assessment for systemic therapy trials
recommendation.mrecist: mRECIST may provide complementary information for locoregional therapy

endpoints.recommendation: OS should remain primary endpoint for RCTs

after_curative_treatment.imaging: CT or MRI every 3-4 months for 2 years, then every 6 months
after_curative_treatment.afp: Every 3-4 months if elevated at baseline

on_systemic_therapy.recommendation: Clinical evaluation and imaging (CT/MRI) every 3-4 months

palliative_care.indication: BCLC D, poor liver function (Child-Pugh C not for transplant), poor performance status
